row.team_price_text: Starting at $1,950/year + consumption (Cloud); Self-Hosted Pro starting at $7,500/year
row.evidence: Sonatype documents SAML ('Only available in Sonatype Nexus Repository Pro') and OIDC sign-in that 'provisions a local user', plus a REST Security Management API, but no SCIM endpoint in its docs or API reference.
row.notes: Sonatype Nexus Repository (Nexus Repository Manager). Pricing is flat plus consumption, not per user: Community Edition free; Pro Cloud from $1,950/year + consumption (25 GB included); Pro Self-Hosted from $7,500/year. SSO (SAML, OIDC from 3.86) and the Audit Log API are Pro features. No SCIM anywhere in help.sonatype.com or the REST API reference; users are created JIT on OIDC sign-in, or pre-provisioned through the REST API (/v1/security/saml/users, new in 3.86) and LDAP/Crowd. The REST API (users, roles) is listed under Community features in the feature matrix. Cloud IdP setup covers Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace, PingFederate and custom OIDC/SAML with IdP group mapping.

limitations.text: No SCIM endpoint: the Security Management API and Swagger reference cover users, roles, SAML users, LDAP and OIDC configuration but no /scim paths.

auth.notes: Permissions are listed per SAML-user endpoint; user tokens (Pro) can replace passwords for REST calls.

endpoints.purpose: Create a user in the default (local) source
Pre-create a SAML user with roles before first login
Update a SAML user's roles and attributes
List a user's Nexus-internal roles (Cloud only)
Add roles to a user (Cloud only)

limitations.text: Local user create/modify is self-hosted only; the user-role endpoints are Cloud only.

okta.notes: Okta is a tested SAML provider; no OIN page found.

entra.notes: Azure AD is a tested SAML provider; no gallery tutorial found.

google.notes: Google Workspace listed in Nexus Repository Cloud IdP configuration.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP and Atlassian Crowd (Pro) user sources; REST pre-provisioning of SAML users; IdP group-to-role mapping
